in_marathi.name: Kamaksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamaksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The goddess of desire, Kamaksha, is a form of Parvati, the consort of Shiva. Her name means 'desire-fulfilling eye' or 'goddess with the enchanting gaze'. Kamaksha is known to bestow blessings of love, fertility, and prosperity upon her devotees.
